questions.q: What is the capital of Uruguay?
questions.why: Almost half of Uruguayans live there.

questions.q: Which country hosted and won the first FIFA World Cup in 1930?
questions.why: It beat Argentina 4–2 in the final.

questions.q: In which year did Uruguay become independent?
questions.why: Independence was confirmed in 1828.

questions.q: Which national hero led Uruguay's early independence struggle?
questions.why: He is called the father of the nation.

questions.q: Which 1950 World Cup win in Rio stunned Brazil?
questions.why: Uruguay won 2–1.

questions.q: Which President lived simply and gave most of his salary away?
questions.why: He was called the world's 'poorest president'.

questions.q: Which neighbours fought over Uruguay before independence?
questions.why: Uruguay became a buffer state.

questions.q: Which group of 33 patriots began the 1825 independence fight?
questions.why: They landed on the Uruguay River.

questions.q: Which two traditional parties dominated Uruguayan politics?
questions.why: They date back to the 1830s.

questions.q: Which President built Uruguay's welfare state in the early 1900s?
questions.why: He made education free and secular.

questions.q: Which 1972 air crash in the Andes involved a Uruguayan rugby team?
questions.why: Sixteen survivors were rescued after 72 days.

questions.q: Which 1973–85 period of military rule did Uruguay go through?
questions.why: It ended with elections in 1984.

questions.q: Which old Portuguese town across from Buenos Aires is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was founded in 1680.

questions.q: In which year did Uruguay legalise cannabis, the first country to do so?
questions.why: The state regulates its sale.

questions.q: Which Uruguayan author wrote 'Open Veins of Latin America'?
questions.why: It was published in 1971.

questions.q: What is Uruguay's currency?
questions.why: Its code is UYU.

questions.q: Which beach resort is Uruguay's most famous?
questions.why: Its 'Hand in the Sand' sculpture is famous.

questions.q: Which herbal drink do Uruguayans carry everywhere in a gourd?
questions.why: Uruguayans drink more mate per person than anyone.

questions.q: Which steak sandwich is Uruguay's national dish?
questions.why: It is piled with ham, cheese, egg and more.

questions.q: Which river forms Uruguay's western border with Argentina?
questions.why: The Río de la Plata estuary is to the south.

questions.q: Which drum-based music of African roots fills Montevideo's carnival?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which Uruguayan striker scored many goals for Barcelona and Liverpool?
questions.why: He is Uruguay's all-time top scorer.

questions.q: Which long carnival in Montevideo lasts about 40 days?
questions.why: It is said to be the world's longest.

questions.q: Which Uruguayan won the Golden Ball at the 2010 World Cup?
questions.why: Uruguay finished fourth.

questions.q: Which famous tango was composed in Montevideo in 1917?
questions.why: It is one of the best-known tangos.

questions.q: Which grilled meat feast is a Sunday tradition?
questions.why: It is cooked on a parrilla.

questions.q: Which stadium hosted the 1930 World Cup final?
questions.why: It was built for the tournament.

questions.q: Which painter founded the 'Universal Constructivism' movement?
questions.why: His inverted map of South America is famous.

questions.q: Which town's meat-packing factory is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It made the famous corned beef.

questions.q: Which landmark building in Montevideo was once South America's tallest?
questions.why: It opened in 1928.
